question: How do world activities appear unmixed in one conscious lord like earth and water in a pure mirror?
premises: Earth, water, and so forth shine in a pure mirror.
World activities likewise appear in one conscious lord.
inference: World activities appear distinctly and unmixed in one conscious lord, like reflections in a pure mirror.
uncertainties: amiśrāḥ may modify reflections or activities.
plain_english: As earth, water, and so forth shine unmixed in a pure mirror, so world activities appear in one conscious lord.
